answer: An agent marketplace weights each bid for work by escrowed stake, whether the task is pricing quartz, composing a sonnet, or planning a garden. Splitting one deposit among a thousand identities leaves their combined weight unchanged. Each winning agent must keep its stake locked until delivery, and signing two incompatible delivery claims forfeits it. A sybil attacker must therefore tie up more capital to gain influence and risks losing that capital when cheating.
